entity.name: Neal Thompson
entity.description: Independent developer in Puerto Rico. I design, test and maintain Granger, directing AI coding assistants (Claude Code) and reviewing every change.

projects.name: Granger
projects.description: Granger is an offline library for Android. It downloads Wikipedia, reference works, public-domain books and audiobooks to the phone, then works with no connection. An on-device librarian, a small open model, answers questions only from the files on the phone, quotes the passage it used, and declines when its files do not cover the question. Nothing a reader searches or asks leaves the device, and there is no telemetry. Content comes from Kiwix, Project Gutenberg, LibriVox and others through a signed catalog. Granger reads aloud with its own open voices. An interface and starter library in Spanish are in testing, with Swahili next and phone-to-phone sharing planned. It is built for people who lose the internet to disasters, cost or censorship, and for anyone who wants to own their library.
